hero.title: File:Cambodia, Tonle Sap IMG 3285.JPG
hero.description: The Tonlé Sap (Khmer: Large Fresh Water River, more commonly translated as Great Lake) — is a lake and river ecosystem in Cambodia. Tonlé Sap is: the largest freshwater lake in Southeast Asia; a river of huge significance in Phnom Penh, Siem Reap province, and Cambodia; and an ecological hotspot that was designated as a UNESCO biosphere reserve in 1997.
